# CCVar

Wolfgate's CVar definitions, kept out of upstream `CCVars`. `WolfgateCVars` holds the general ones (`wf.ui_style`,
`wf.anatomy_enabled`, `wf.anatomy_notice_seen`, `wf.ui_window_popout`, `wf.spawn_favourites`);
`CollisionWarningCVars`, `HeatHazeCVars`, `InternetSoundCVars`, `ShipAccessCVars` and `ShockwaveCVars` tune the
collision warning, heat haze, internet sounds, ship access locking and explosion shockwaves.
